content:
morgan: heads-up: deploy-bot blocked promote for search-worker -> staging. Error shows artifact index checksum mismatch and shard 404. Release window in ~30m. any quick unblock?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion blocked: artifact-index checksum mismatch for search-worker:2026-03-02-rc5
```
2026-03-23T10:12:03Z ERROR PutObject shard-0 -> 404 Not Found
meta: expected=8f3a7c1d2, observed=UNKNOWN, cache-ttl=300s
```

sam: likely cache manifest TTL drifted during mirror rotation. Options: pin to last-good (search-worker:2026-02-28-rc9) or reupload rc5. Pin is fastest.

jen: pin sounds right for the window. Reupload + cache warm will take >10m and might miss canary. We should document the pin in release notes.

morgan: any functional risk with rc9?
sam: rc9 only had a metrics flag behind FF. No schema changes. Low risk.

ben (release-manager): proceed with pin + hold canary. I'll update notes and file follow-up.

carla (oncall): i'll start a parallel mirror copy for rc5 so we have the reupload ready if we want to flip post-release. running:
```
gsutil -m cp -r gs://artifacts-staging/tmp-upload/search-worker/rc5/* gs://artifacts-staging/mirrors/search-worker/rc5/
```

deploy-bot: action performed: `promote --pin search-worker:2026-02-28-rc9` executed by ben at 1746732500. Canary state: held (1/3). Mirror reupload started.

morgan: ben please add release note: "pinned search-worker to 2026-02-28-rc9 due to artifact index TTL drift causing shard 404; rc5 mirror reupload in progress; will reconcile after release."

ben: added to release notes, created follow-up ticket RED-3145.

carla: mirror reupload completed, checksums for rc5 now match expected (8f3a7c1d2) but canary remains pinned per release decision.

morgan: final: pinned + canary held. triage tomorrow to decide flip. closing thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
